Embedded Software Engineer I (Onsite)
Fullerton, CA
Full-time
Onsite
Entry Level
$63K/yr - $120K/yr
RTX develops aerospace and defense technologies and provides opportunities to work on complex engineering problems. The Embedded Software Engineer I will design, code, integrate, test, and document real-time embedded software for radar, sensor, guidance, and fire control systems while contributing across the software development lifecycle. The role also involves troubleshooting, requirements analysis, peer reviews, and supporting program execution.

Responsibilities
Work on complex technical problems and collaborate to provide innovative solutions. Requires investigation and troubleshooting skills to assess issues and develop resolutions
Work at all phases of the SW development lifecycle, including SW/HW integration, dependent on program phase
Assist in the derivation of system and software requirements, architectural modeling, and technical analysis
Design, code, unit test, integrate, and document real-time embedded software solutions with a focus on Raytheon’s Radar Digital Product Line (RDPL)
Participate actively in software peer reviews, code inspections, and technical decision-making alongside multidisciplinary teams, including program leadership and customers
Support program execution to ensure work products meet technical, cost, schedule, and quality baselines
Follow established software development processes and practices to maintain software product integrity
Work Location: Onsite at our Fullerton, CA Campus
This position requires the eligibility to obtain a security clearance. Except in rare circumstances, only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Required
The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required.​  U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
Active and existing security clearance required after day 1
Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline from an accredited institution. Degree must be obtained by start date
Experience developing, and testing or debugging software using C, C++, or similar object-oriented programming language
Strong Object-Oriented Design knowledge and real time embedded software development experience
Strong hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving experience
Experience developing software in a team-based development environment with strong teamwork and communication skills
Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects
Preferred
Knowledge of Software Development Processes and experience participating in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, implementation, and testing
Experience working with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and automated build environments
Familiarity with Scrum/Agile, DevSecOps, Git/GitLab
Experience with Linux development environments
Hands-on experience with scripting languages (Python, Perl, Bash) for automation and testing
Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and system software design
Exposure to radar systems, Digital Signal Processing (DSP), or real-time embedded software
